name: linguist-js 3.0.4
about: JavaScript re-implementation of Linguist's rules (npm linguist-js): modeline, file name, shebang, extension, then Linguist's heuristics; no classifier (the first candidate wins); run offline on the Linguist data bundled in the package (languages.yml as of Linguist b45dbe9, 2026-08-20); child languages, not their group
